command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/selective-tape-restore
req="$base/restore-request.txt"
archive="$base/tapes/friday.tar"
live="$base/live"
count=0
while IFS= read -r member || [ -n "$member" ]; do
  count=$((count + 1))
  case "$member" in invoices/INV-[0-9]*.txt) ;; *) printf 'unsafe-or-unexpected request entry: %s\n' "$member" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  case "$member" in /*|*../*|../*|*'/..') printf 'unsafe path: %s\n' "$member" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  matches=$(tar -tf "$archive" | grep -Fxc -- "$member")
  [ "$matches" -eq 1 ] || { printf 'archive match count %s for %s\n' "$matches" "$member" >&2; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e "$live/$member" ] || { printf 'requested target already exists: %s\n' "$member" >&2; exit 1; }
  printf 'validated %s archive_count=%s expected_sha256=' "$member" "$matches"
  tar -xOf "$archive" -- "$member" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
  tar -tvf "$archive" -- "$member"
done < "$req"
[ "$count" -eq 2 ]
dupes=$(sort "$req" | uniq -d | wc -l)
[ "$dupes" -eq 0 ]
printf 'validated_request_count=%s duplicate_count=%s\n' "$count" "$dupes"
